observed: Clear, focused layout; the password visibility button has an 18×18px box.
suggestion: Increase its clickable area while keeping the icon size; align recovery links consistently with their fields.

observed: Recovery appears as another white card over a dimmed login card; parts of the original login remain visible around it.
suggestion: Use one recovery surface on the branded background, or more clearly distinguish the recovery dialog from the background. Add a compact Email → Code → Finish progress cue.

observed: Six labelled boxes fit the narrow viewport; the resend countdown and Change email action are clear.
suggestion: Preserve these behaviors. Shorten the surrounding copy and reserve stable space for errors so the controls do not jump.

observed: A five-line password checklist occupies much of the recovery card.
suggestion: Use a more compact checklist and the same password-visibility control pattern as Change Password and Add Administrator.

observed: Large hero and tall summary cards consume most of the first screen; operational content starts far down.
suggestion: Compress the hero and cards to bring the map and recent activity higher. Keep values and their labels together.

observed: The link points to `/locations`, rather than directly opening a creation form. That directory's Add Location flow creates indoor places only.
suggestion: Rename it “Open Locations,” or provide an explicit create choice that leads directly to the appropriate indoor-location or building workflow.

observed: Several full-width chart cards make a long page; range selection remains in the hero above the charts.
suggestion: Keep a compact range/header visible while scrolling, add exact date ranges, and reduce repeated introductory space. Make chart units and definitions consistent in sentence case.

observed: Floor choices repeat visible labels such as “1st Floor,” “2nd Floor,” and “Ground Floor.”
suggestion: Normalize equivalent floor values before presenting them; sort in physical order. If values genuinely differ, disambiguate them. Add active-filter chips and a single Clear filters action.
caveat: The screenshot locates the closed native floor selector. Duplicate option labels were read from its live DOM options; the native popup is not visible in this capture.

observed: The directory says “67 locations,” while pagination says “1–10 of 52” in the initial grouped view. These appear to count different things.
suggestion: Label them explicitly: total places versus top-level records/buildings, or use one consistent count. Include child counts on building/floor groups.

observed: Editing a Building still displays “Add a Room, Office, Laboratory, or Restroom under an existing Building.” The indoor form places coordinates before required parent/floor fields.
suggestion: Use entity-specific edit copy. Ask for name, type, building, and floor first; then show optional map position and photos.

observed: “Pick on map” appears in the creation form even though the documented workflow requires saving the record first.
suggestion: Explain that prerequisite next to the action, and give newly saved indoor places a direct “Place marker” next step. Distinguish inherited routing from an optional indoor marker position in the helper text.

observed: Photo controls add considerable content to an already scrolling dialog.
suggestion: Keep optional photos collapsed until selected; show a concise count and thumbnail preview. Preserve the fixed save/cancel footer.

observed: Tool dock, basemap switch, search, legend, issues tray, and inspector all compete for map area.
suggestion: Give selection/editing a clearer hierarchy; collapse secondary overlays when an inspector opens, while keeping their state recoverable. Use concise tool instructions.

observed: A red validation message appears immediately at zero plotted points, before the user has done anything wrong.
suggestion: Show neutral guidance such as “Place at least 3 corners”; show an error after an invalid attempt. Add a clear Finish drawing action when valid.

observed: Building association is a long native select. The fixture includes repeated building names with different identifiers and many unnamed OSM buildings.
suggestion: Use a searchable building picker, display name plus code, and clarify the available record sources. Preserve typed identity; do not merge records solely because their names match. The record duplication observed here is fixture-specific.
caveat: The screenshot locates the closed association selector. Its 199 building choices and repeated fixture names were read from the live DOM options; the native popup is not visible.

observed: The fixture has 168 “No entrance” issues, including many identically named unnamed buildings.
suggestion: Add filtering/search and a distinguishing code or map context to each row. Keep the existing focus-on-map behavior. Treat the count as fixture data, not a production quality assessment.
caveat: Repeated unnamed records and issue counts are properties of the fixture dataset, not a production data assessment.

observed: “Not routable” and entrance count appear near the top, but Add entrance is below the indoor location list and can require scrolling.
suggestion: Put the action that resolves the routing problem beside that status. Keep indoor contents as a secondary expandable section.

observed: Search and two filters occupy only the left portion of a wide filter card. Search has a placeholder but no persistent visible label. “Showing 60 users” sits above a ten-row page.
suggestion: Widen search, label it, align filters to a common baseline, add status filtering, and say “60 matching users” above pagination.

observed: The account table is clear, but all actions are hidden in an ellipsis menu. Add Administrator uses a different password visibility pattern from other password forms.
suggestion: Keep the menu, group access changes separately from password reset/removal, and reuse one password field component with a visibility toggle.

observed: Search is narrow enough to truncate its purpose; long absolute timestamps dominate rows. The detail dialog repeats most row information, and its category badge stretches across the dialog.
suggestion: Give search flexible width and a persistent label. Add timezone information, use compact dates with full timestamps available, make the category badge content-sized, and emphasize the event's actual detail.

observed: Account actions are separated from Sign Out by the entire backup history; prototype controls overlay the page in development.
suggestion: Keep account actions together, move backup administration into a clearly separate section or page, and remove prototype controls from the normal review/use flow. Resolve persistence first.

observed: Failed jobs use a muted badge similar to neutral states; schedule controls and ready archives look operational despite the prototype implementation.
suggestion: Give failure a distinct icon/tone and an explicit “View failure details” action. State simulation status prominently until persistent controls are wired.

observed: An essentially unstyled heading and paragraph sit at the top of an otherwise empty page, with no recovery action.
suggestion: Apply the app's spacing and branded card style. Add “Go to Dashboard” and “Back to Login.”
